note: Set A is preferred because it avoids the severe text hallucinations found in Set B (e.g., 'FLAT BLACK', 'SINGLE HOUGHY'), which are not present in the source text. While Set A suffers from significant redundancy and one logic error regarding the Solar Envelope height reference (claiming 18' from Finished Floor instead of Grade Level), Set B introduces multiple fabricated quotes and misattributes the cable railing diameter to the column thickness. Set B does capture useful sheet notes, but the fidelity issues outweigh this benefit.
